approval: archive-completed-verification-branches: Архивировать и удалить четыре ссылки
verification: Complete history; git bundle verify, fetch into fresh restore-check.git, exact four tips and git fsck --full passed. Unborn default HEAD notice is expected in bare verification repository.
limits: Local backup only, not off-host. Preserve archive and restore-check.git. Never garbage collect archive based on branch removal.
recovery: Verify SHA256, then git init --bare <new-empty-path> and git -C <new-empty-path> fetch <bundle> refs/heads/<branch>:refs/heads/<branch> for each listed branch; compare full tips. Remote restoration requires separate authorization.
